Kheelona is a Bengaluru‑based company that builds AI‑powered, screen‑free learning toys, and its flagship product Kheelu is an interactive conversational AI toy for children aged 3+, designed to teach through stories, dialogue, and adaptive memory.
What Is Kheelona?

Kheelona is an AI toy company focused on early‑childhood learning and language development.

It creates screen‑free, voice‑interactive toys that support children’s learning through conversation, stories, and games. 
CB Insights
The company is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. 
CB Insights
Its technology is built on PlayOS, an on‑device AI platform that powers toys with speech recognition, safety filters, and multi‑language support. 
kheelona.ai
What Is the Kheelu AI Toy?

Kheelu is Kheelona’s flagship product — a screen‑free AI companion for children aged 3+.
Key features include:

Conversational learning: Kheelu listens, answers, and asks follow‑up questions, enabling natural back‑and‑forth dialogue. 
kheelona.com
On‑device processing: Speech is processed locally for privacy, low latency, and safety; the toy does not connect to the open internet. 
kheelona.com
Adaptive memory: Kheelu remembers what a child knows, their pace, and their interests, adjusting content over time. 
kheelona.com
Multi‑language support: Up to ten home languages are supported. 
kheelona.com
Story mode: Interactive stories that children can interrupt, question, and learn from offline. 
kheelona.com
Safety layers: All responses pass through age‑graded safety filters. 
kheelona.com
Pricing: Pre‑order pricing starts at ₹499, with dispatch pricing around ₹4,500–₹4,999 depending on the batch. 
kheelona.com
+1
How Kheelu Works

Kheelu operates through a structured interaction loop:

Talk & Play: The child asks questions or plays word games.
Kheelu Remembers: The toy tracks vocabulary, interests, and learning pace.
Knowledge Builds: New ideas are introduced through natural conversation.
Repeat: Each cycle adapts to the child’s growth. 
kheelona.com
Technology Behind Kheelu
Powered by PlayOS, which includes voice‑to‑voice AI, safety filters, OTA updates, and multi‑language support. 
kheelona.ai
Runs on a palm‑sized module with an MCU, mic array, and speaker. 
kheelona.ai
Designed for screen‑free, child‑safe interaction.

Kheelona and Kheelu together represent a new category of on‑device AI toys focused on safe, conversational, and personalized early‑childhood learning.
